geometry.general_sections: n-2 of a globally generated rank-n bundle, n>=3

construction: Twist a supplied rank-n bundle G by a sufficiently ample power, choose n-2 general sections, and take the rank-two reflexive cokernel F. Its smooth codimension-three degeneracy locus D has [D]=c3(G(m))=c3(F), with P6[D]=2 P6 kappa3(G).
equivalences: some rank-two reflexive F on X has P6 kappa3(F) nonzero
some smooth codimension-three D in X has P6[D] nonzero
actual_control: For sufficiently ample L, a general map O_X^2 -> L^4 has smooth codimension-three degeneracy locus D and rank-two reflexive cokernel. The class [D]=4*c1(L)^3 and kappa3(F)=2*c1(L)^3 are nonzero but have zero Weil projection. No numerical section coefficients are supplied.
positivity_boundary: Nonzero effective threefolds have positive E^3 degree, whereas pure Weil classes have degree zero. A positive witness D must retain a divisor background; Hodge algebraicity permits rational signed representatives of alpha.
next_action: Supply a genuine smooth threefold whose class is not proportional to E^3, or a rank-two reflexive sheaf with non-divisor codimension-three Ext1 singularity cycle. A supplied higher-rank bundle can be reduced by the licensed generic-section construction. Singularities only in codimension at least four, split-bundle determinantal controls and a demand for pure effective Weil class do not solve the witness problem.
trust_scope: Written global-generation, generic determinantal transversality, Porteous and depth/reflexivity proofs, plus derived duality and support-codimension argument for the rank-two singularity cycle. Exact rational twist/normalization controls, duality-polynomial identities and ample-degree computation. Standard algebraic geometry is imported; formal nonzero-Weil characters are not supplied bundles. No proof-assistant certification or algebraicity decision.
